title: COVID-19 mRNA Vaccine-Associated Myocarditis Presenting as STEMI in a 48-Year-Old Male.
ehr_evidence: Clinical case report based on direct patient evaluation, laboratory testing, and imaging at Memorial Healthcare System.
summary: Case report of a 48-year-old male presenting with STEMI and myocarditis shortly after receiving the second dose of the Moderna COVID-19 mRNA vaccine, with rapid resolution of symptoms and cardiac markers.
key_findings: Coronary angiography revealed normal and patent coronary arteries.
Symptoms and cardiac markers resolved rapidly following discharge.
limitations: cardiac MRI unavailable for definitive diagnosis
data_availability_statement: The data used to support the ﬁndings of this study are included within the article.
